The final manufacture check passed because the last manufacturing step occurred in the UAE, and the minimal operations were completed. All three non‑originating inputs are classified outside subheading 761010, satisfying CTSH, and the qualifying value addition is 49.0% on an FOB price basis, exceeding the 45% threshold.
